# Python dependencies for the Conker decomp toolchain.
#
# The spimdisasm / rabbitizer pins below are LOAD-BEARING, not hygiene.
#
#   * spimdisasm formats the disassembly text and rabbitizer formats the
#     instructions, so both decide the exact bytes of conker/asm/**.s.
#   * The preserved asm/ tree in this repo was produced by spimdisasm 1.40.1
#     (every generated file carries "/* Generated by spimdisasm 1.40.1 */").
#   * tools/n64splat/requirements.txt only asks for spimdisasm>=1.33.0 /
#     rabbitizer>=1.10.0. PyPI is already at spimdisasm 1.42.x, so an
#     unconstrained install silently drifts to a version whose output has never
#     been validated against the byte-perfect ROM gate.
#
# Install BOTH requirement files in ONE pip invocation so the resolver honours
# these pins (setup.sh does this):
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt -r tools/n64splat/requirements.txt
#
# Bumping either pin is a deliberate change: re-run `make -C conker extract`
# followed by the full-clean ROM gate before committing the new version.

ansiwrap
attrs
capstone
colorama
cxxfilt
# tools/mips_to_c (m2c) imports pycparser.plyparser, removed in pycparser 3.x
pycparser<3
pylibyaml
pynacl
pypng
python-Levenshtein
python-ranges
pyyaml
toml
watchdog

# --- n64splat disassembly stack: exact pins, see header ---
spimdisasm==1.40.1
rabbitizer==1.15.0
